ترتجعوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَجِعُوا (tartajiʕū) /tar.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# تُرْتَجَعُوا (turtajaʕū) /tur.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
